newsitem.title: USA: Dlr finishes mixed in US, eyes Tietmeyer comments.
newsitem.headline: Dlr finishes mixed in US, eyes Tietmeyer comments.

text.p: *Dlr closes weaker against mark. Holds on to mild gains vs yen *Dlr/mark lower after Tietmeyer says Buba not seeking further mark weakness, but dollar/yen up despite trade reports. Commerce's Ehrlich says dollar level not major factor affecting trade data. *Dlr/yen also helped by favorable interest rate differentials. *Univ. of Mich prelim due Friday at 1000 EDT. April seen 99.8.
